embeddium.conflicting_mod: Embeddium detected the presence of mods that are known to cause rendering issues/crashes. It is recommended to uninstall them. See the list below.
Controls the resolution of the game in fullscreen mode.
iron.options.use_quad_normals_for_lighti:
When enabled, Embeddium will apply shading to non-vanilla block faces based on the true direction they are facing, not their axis-aligned direction. This can improve lighting quality when the Forge experimental light pipeline is disabled (which is recommended for best performance).

It has no effect if the experimental light pipeline is enabled.
embeddium.options.use_render_pass_optimi:
When enabled, Embeddium will detect block model faces that are marked as transparent (or translucent) when the texture is actually opaque (or transparent) and automatically use a more optimal render pass for them.

This optimization has no effect when a shader pack is active.
embeddium.options.show_fps.name: Show FPS
embeddium.options.show_fps.tooltip: When enabled, displays the current frames per second in the top-left corner of the screen.
embeddium.options.show_debug_stats.name: Show OptiCore Debug Stats
embeddium.options.show_debug_stats.toolt: When enabled, adds OptiCore frame-time and entity-culling statistics to the F3 debug screen.
iron.options.performance_history.enabled: When enabled, Iron will continuously record performance metrics like FPS, frame time, memory usage, and entity counts. This data can be visualized in-game or exported for analysis.
iron.options.performance_history.show_gr: Displays a real-time performance graph overlay in the bottom-right corner showing FPS history, 1% low FPS, and memory usage. The graph updates continuously while playing.
iron.options.performance_history.detect_: Automatically detects significant FPS drops and logs them with game state information. Useful for identifying what causes stuttering or lag spikes.
iron.options.performance_history.samplin: Controls how often performance snapshots are captured in milliseconds. Lower values provide more detailed data but use slightly more memory. Default is 1000ms (1 second).
iron.options.performance_history.auto_ex: Automatically exports a performance report as JSON when you exit the game. Reports are saved to config/performance-reports/ and include statistics and all captured snapshots.
